name: steam-web
description: Unofficial Steam Web API reader: library, playtime, achievements, friends, profiles, workshop, trades, and official catalog. Not affiliated with Valve.

STEAM_WEB_API_KEY.title: Steam Web API key
STEAM_WEB_API_KEY.description: From https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey (user key). Stored locally on the installer machine. Never committed.

STEAM_ID.title: Default SteamID64
STEAM_ID.description: Optional 64-bit SteamID used when a tool omits steamid. Leave blank if you will pass steamid per call.
